FLIS.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable item sounds

FLIS.Settings.Debug.Name: Console debugging

FLIS.Warn.GmOnly: Only a GM can configure Item SFX.
FLIS.Warn.NoPlaylist: The assigned playlist was not found.
FLIS.Warn.NoSound: The assigned playlist sound was not found.
FLIS.Tools.Title: Item SFX tools
FLIS.Tools.Explanation: Maintenance operations for actor and item compendium roundtrips.
FLIS.Tools.BackupNotes: Rebuilds actor backups for world actors, synthetic token actors, and actors in unlocked compendiums. Unambiguous legacy backup matches are preserved even before they are written back to the Item.
FLIS.Tools.RestoreNotes: Run this first after upgrading: it writes missing Item SFX from the actor backup back to embedded Items. Ambiguous matches are never guessed.
FLIS.Tools.AuditNotes: Count missing playlists, sounds, and ambiguous backup matches without changing documents.
FLIS.Tools.BackupDone: Backups rebuilt. Actors: {actors}. Items: {items}. Failed: {failed}. Skipped: {skipped}.
FLIS.Tools.RestoreDone: Restore finished. Actors: {actors}. Restored: {restored}. Ambiguous: {ambiguous}. Failed: {failed}. Skipped: {skipped}.
FLIS.Tools.AuditDone: Audit finished. Configured: {configured}. Missing playlists: {missingPlaylist}. Missing sounds: {missingSound}. Ambiguous backups: {ambiguousBackup}.
FLIS.Tools.ConfirmBackup: This overwrites the stored Item SFX backup for every affected actor. Continue?
FLIS.Tools.ConfirmRestore: This writes missing Item SFX settings back to embedded items. Continue?
FLIS.Tools.CompendiumWarning: Unlocked compendiums are included and may also be modified.
